source: 748 Despair Ritual
target: 748 Rituale Desperationis

source: 748 Despair Ritual
target: 748 Rituale Desperationis

source: Madam Magician confirmed Lumian’s guess, “Yes, the remains of Omebella, the Goddess of Harvest.”
target: Magistra Magica coniecturam Lumiani confirmavit: “Ita, reliquiae Omebellae, Deae Messis.”

source: The remains of the Goddess of Harvest… a Grade O Sealed Artifact… contact should be possible and briefly usable… Lumian asked eagerly, “What are the other two prerequisites, besides merging with the remnants of Omebella’s umbilical cord?”
target: Reliquiae Deae Messis… artifactum sigillatum gradus O… contactus fieri debet et brevi tempore usui praesto… Lumian avidissime rogavit: “Quae sunt altera duo praerequisita, praeter fusionem cum reliquiis funiculi umbilicalis Omebellae?”

source: Magician laughed self-deprecatingly and said, “I really shouldn’t have told you this; it’s spurred you to truly consider taking risks.
target: Magica subridente seipsam vituperans dixit: “Revera non debui tibi hoc dicere; id te ad pericula subeunda vere impulsit.”

source: “Of course, as a high-ranking Astromancer, I can’t say I didn’t foresee this. Telling you everything and letting you decide is my choice.
target: “Certe, ut summus Astromancer, non possum dicere me hoc non praevidisse. Omnia tibi narrare et tibi decernendi facultatem relinquere mihi arbitrium est.”

source: “The two prerequisites are: “First, you must have been betrayed by a direct relative; second, you must be female.”
target: “Dua praerequisita sunt: Primo, proditus a cognato recto esse debes; Secundo, oportet te esse feminam.”

source: Wh-—This clearly disappointed Lumian.
target: Hoc plane Lumian displicuit.

source: He felt he met the betrayal requirement, as his biological father had abandoned him and his mother, leading to his grandfather’s bankruptcy.
target: Sensi me praerequisitum proditionis adimplevisse, cum pater meus biologicus eum et matrem reliquerit, quod ad ruinam avi duxit.

source: But why did he have to be a woman?
target: Sed cur oportuit eum feminam esse?

source: Madam Magician seemed to guess his thoughts.
target: Magistra Magica videbatur eius cogitationes coniectare.

source: “You barely meet the betrayal criterion. As for being female, in the world of mysticism, there are ways to temporarily transform you into a woman, such as a special mystical item from the Demoness pathway, which doesn’t necessarily require a high Sequence.
target: “Vix ad praerequisitum proditionis convenis. Quoad feminam, in mundo mystico sunt modi temporarii quibus te in feminam convertere possis, ut exempli gratia per rem mysticam specialem ex via Demonessa, quae non necessario altam Sequentiam requirit.”

source: “That’s true…” Lumian thought of the Lie earring.
target: “Ita vero…” Lumian de “Auriculis Mendacibus” cogitavit.

source: Although it couldn’t change his gender, its ability to alter appearances or adjust height was equally magical.
target: Quamquam generum eius mutare non potuit, facultas eius ad speciem mutandam aut altitudinem accommodandam aeque magica erat.

source: If such items existed, then surely there must be artifacts that could change one’s gender, which, given Lumian’s understanding of the Demoness path, he believed to be almost certainly existent, albeit rare and special.
target: Si talia essent, certe debent esse artifacta quae generum transformare possint, quae – ratione cognitionis Lumiani de via Demonessa – quasi certo exsistere existimavit, etiamsi rara et specialia.

source: Lumian’s hope was rekindled about accessing Omebella’s remains.
target: Spes Lumiani, ad reliquias Omebellae accedendi, iterum renata est.

source: That was a Grade O Sealed Artifact!
target: Id erat artifactum sigillatum gradus O!

source: Madam Magician, with a quirky expression, gave another reminder. “If you truly consume Omebella’s umbilical cord remnants and possess the bloodline of the Great Mother, you will forever be unable to approach Pride Armor.
target: Magistra Magica, vultu insolito, aliam admonitionem edidit: “Si vere reliquias funiculi umbilicalis Omebellae consumas et sanguinem Magnæ Matris habeas, in aeternum ad Armaturam Superbiæ accedere non poteris.”

source: “Your backstabbing of it would fade over time, but once you become a false Omebella, it will target you first and always, unless there’s someone more special present who’s worth targeting.”
target: “Tua proditione tergi tempore evanescet; sed cum falsam Omebellam fias, illa te primum et semper adpetet, nisi aliquis specialis, qui id meritum sit, adsit.”

source: Is this a manifestation of Pride Armor’s hatred for the Earth pathway?
target: Num hoc est manifestatio odii Armaturæ Superbiæ erga viam Terræ?

source: In future battles, if I’m nearby, Franca and the others won’t be able to use Pride Armor…
target: In proeliis futuris, si prope sim, Franca et ceteri Armaturam Superbiæ uti non poterint…

source: However, between Pride Armor and a Grade O Sealed Artifact, any sane person knows which to choose, even if the latter is only for temporary use…
target: Tamen, inter Armaturam Superbiæ et artifactum sigillatum gradus O, quisquam mens sana scit quam eligere oporteat, etiamsi ultimum solum ad tempus sit.

source: Lumian nodded, indicating he understood.
target: Lumian capite annuit, significans se intellexisse.

source: Madam Magician didn’t continue the topic.
target: Magistra Magica rem non prosequebat.

source: “The deal with the Eternal Blazing Sun Church can move forward. Let me know the agreed time and place for the transaction.
target: “Pactum cum Ecclesia Solis Æterni Flammei procedere potest. Mihi indica tempus et locum consensum pro transactione.”

source: “That Sealed Artifact can’t be transferred by you; it’s too dangerous. Have the Purifiers prepare to seal it on-site; she will appear herself.”
target: “Illud artifactum sigillatum a te transferi nequit; nimis periculosum est. Purificatores praeparent ut in loco id sigillent; ipsa se ostendet.”

source: “Alright.” Lumian took this opportunity to relay other information he had gathered in the past few days.
target: “Recte.” Lumian hoc tempore usus est ut alias notitias quas paucis diebus collegisset referret.

source: Hearing that the Demon Warlock Burman was influenced by Harrison from Resurrection Island, wanting to touch the mark of deep death, and the evil spirit he summoned and killed was suspected to be himself, Madam Magician turned her head towards Mr. Hanged Man.
target: Audivit quod Demonum Warlock Burman a Harrison de Insula Resurrectione influentia affectus esset, cum cupiret signum mortis profundi attingere, et quod spiritus malus quem evocavit necavisset suspiceretur; itaque Magistra Magica caput convertit ad Dominum “Hanged Man.”

source: Lumian had previously heard from Madam Magician that the Tarot Club was already investigating Resurrection Island, specifically Mr. Hanged Man and Ma‘am Hermit.
target: Lumian antea a Magistra Magica audiverat Club Taroticum iam Insulam Resurrectionem investigare, in specie Mr. Hanged Man et Domina Hermit.

source: The one known as the ‘Stormbringer’ among the Major Arcana cards thoughtfully said, “This is related to something I’m investigating.
target: Ille, notus inter chartas Major Arcana ut “Tempestam Fertorem”, cogitans dixit: “Hoc pertinet ad rem quam investigo.”

source: “I can’t reveal the specifics yet, but you should know Harrison is likely to appear in places closely linked to death, darkness, dusk, and decay. If you encounter someone of unknown origin in such scenarios, remember to tell me.”
target: “Non possum adhuc particularia revelare, sed scito quod Harrison probabiliter in locis arcte connexis cum morte, tenebris, crepusculo, et corruptione appariturus sit. Si aliquem ignotum in talibus occasionibus occursurus fueris, memento mihi indicare.”

source: Death, darkness, dusk, decay.. Truly someone from Resurrection Island… Lumian wasn’t surprised by Mr. Hanged Man’s hint.
target: Mors, tenebrae, crepusculum, corruptio… Vere aliquis ex Insula Resurrectionis… Lumian implicationem Domini “Hanged Man” non miratus est.

source: He was more concerned about whether Resurrection Island’s ‘resurrection’ was indeed a true resurrection.
target: Magis autem curabat utrum “resurrectio” Insulae Resurrectionis revera esset.

source: Madam Magician could read what he was pondering.
target: Magistra Magica videre poterat quid ille meditaret.

source: “I’ve said before, we aren’t Beyonders of the Death pathway, so we don’t fundamentally understand the situation on Resurrection Island, and it’s difficult to have a precise view of their so-called ‘resurrection.’ Maybe a direct encounter with Harrison or another islander will provide the insights you’re seeking.
target: “Iam dixi, non sumus Beyonders viæ Mortis, itaque casum Insulae Resurrectionis non radicitus intellegimus, nec facile accuratam visionem de eorum ‘resurrectione’ habere possumus. Forsitan conventus directus cum Harrison aut alio insulana perspicacitatem, quam quaeris, afferet.”

source: “The only thing I can say now is, think about Demon Warlock Burman. His condition had clearly worsened since Harrison led him to kill what seemed to be his own evil spirit. The inhabitants of Resurrection Island likely have issues.
target: “Unum nunc dicere possum: cogita de Demon Warlock Burman. Eius condicio manifeste peior facta est ex quo Harrison eum ad occidendum, quod videbatur esse proprium spiritum malum, duxit. Incolae Insulae Resurrectionis verisimiliter quaestiones habent.”

source: “Heh, I was right last time when I said the Arden evil spirit might still be alive after the related ritual.”
target: “Heh, recte prius dixi spiritum malum Arden fortasse post ritum pertinens adhuc vivere.”

source: Lumian fell silent.
target: Lumian siluit.

source: Upon returning to Trier, Lumian promptly made his way to 9 Rue Orosai and knocked on the door of Room 702.
target: Revertens ad Trier, Lumian celeriter ad 9 Rue Orosai pervenit et ianuam Cubiculi 702 pulsavit.

source: “Why are you here again?” Franca opened the door with a look of disdain.
target: “Cur iterum hic es?” Franca ianuam aperuit vultu contemptus.

source: He had left less than an hour ago!
target: Abiit ante minus quam horam!

source: Fortunately, it was daytime.
target: Fortunate, tempus diurnum erat.

source: She hadn’t been planning anything yet—what if she had been scared out of her wits?
target: Nihil praeparaverat—quid si metu extremo oppressa esset?

source: Lumian glanced at Jenna, who was curled up on the living room sofa with a book, propping herself up to look at him.
target: Lumian Jennam intuebatur, quae in sofa conclavi cum libro relaxata erat, ut eum aspiceret.

source: He smiled at the two Demonesses and said, “I’ve managed to obtain the potion formula of the Demoness of Despair.”
target: Subridens duabus Demonessibus dixit: “Formula potionis Demonessae Desperationis adeptus sum.”

source: “Ah?” Franca looked puzzled.
target: “Ah?” Franca, vultu perplexo, aspexit.

source: Hadn’t he just acquired the Iron-blooded Knight potion formula?
target: Num non modo formula potionis “Equitis Ferro-Sanguinei” modo adeptus eras?

source: Or had he accomplished something significant in the few minutes since he left?
target: An aliquid magnum in paucis minutis postquam discessit perfecit?

source: Jenna was equally baffled, thinking Lumian was joking at first.
target: Jenna similiter perplexa erat, putans Lumian initio iocari.

source: Despair was a Sequence 4 potion formula that contained the method humans used to pry open the gates to godhood.
target: Desperatio erat formula potionis Sequenciae IV, quae modum continens patefaciendi portas ad deitatem ab hominibus adhibitus erat.

source: How could it be obtained so easily?
target: Quomodo ita facile obtiniri potuit?

source: In a flash of thought, Franca and Jenna asked in unison: “Did you go to the Blue Avenger?”
target: In momento cogitationis, Franca et Jenna simul rogaverunt: “Accessisti ad Blue Avenger?”

source: “Have you finished exploring the Blue Avenger?”
target: “Num Blue Avenger exploravisti?”

source: “Just a preliminary exploration,” Lumian squeezed past Franca, smiling as he spoke.
target: “Modo exploratio praevia,” Lumian praeter Francam transiit, subridente loquens.

source: “You got the Demoness of Despair potion formula from just a preliminary exploration?”
target: “Ex solâ exploratione praevia tantum formula potionis Demonessae Desperationis adeptus es?”

source: Jenna asked, somewhat incredulously.
target: Jenna quaesivit, aliquantulum incrédula.

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian subridens risit.

source: “That’s one of the Blood Emperor’s legacies. A Sequence 4 potion formula should be considered pretty normal among the treasures.”
target: “Hoc est unum ex legato Imperatoris Sanguinis. Formula potionis Sequenciae IV inter thesauros prorsus ordinaria esse debet.”

source: “What else did you find?” Franca asked curiously after closing the door.
target: “Quid aliud invenisti?” Franca post ianuam claudendam curiosa rogavit.

source: Lumian casually took a seat on an armchair and recounted his adventure aboard the Blue Avenger, including his interactions with Madam Magician and Mr. Hanged Man from start to finish.
target: Lumian in sellam bracchatam consedit et narravit suum adventum in Blue Avenger, inter quos interactiones cum Magistra Magica et Mr. Hanged Man a principio ad finem comprehensae erant.

source: “That corpse wax candle sounds rather sinister,” Franca genuinely exclaimed.
target: “Illum candela cera ex cadavere valde sinistrum sonat,” Franca vere exclamavit.

source: Jenna nodded in agreement, feeling like she had just heard a horror story.
target: Jenna capite annuit, consensu effuso, sensa quasi nuper fabulam horroris audivisset.

source: As a Beyonder of the Demoness pathway, friend of a Hunter, hearing that the candle was made from the corpse oils of an Iron-blooded Knight and a Demoness of Despair always made her inadvertently think of herself, Franca, and Lumian.
target: Ut Beyonder viæ Demonessae, et amica venatoris, audivit candela ex oleis cadaverum Equitis Ferro-Sanguinei et Demonessae Desperationis factam esse, semper inopinato ad se, Francam, et Lumianum reminiscens.

source: Just as Jenna felt Franca had voiced her own thoughts, she heard her female companion eagerly propose, “Last time in Fourth Epoch Trier, I barely saw what that misty city looked like.
target: Iam, cum Jenna sensit Francam suas cogitationes exprimere, audivit comitem feminam suam ferventer proponere: “Ultima vice in Trier Quarta Aetate vix vidi qualis illa urbs nebulosa appareret.”

source: You didn’t describe it clearly enough.
target: Non satis clare eam enarrasti.

source: Can I use that candle to make a pact and see the misty city from inside or from the air?
target: Licetne mihi illa candelam ad pactum faciendum et ad urbum nebulosum intus aut ex aere intuendum uti?

source: “You guys be my guardians!”
target: “Vos sitis mei custodes!”

source: “That candle burns very quickly. I only tried it once, and it used up a fifth of it,” Lumian thought aloud, “Let’s wait for a chance to visit Bansy Harbor or enter Fourth Epoch Trier, then you can try it.
target: “Illa candela celeriter ardet. Semel tantum experior, et quinta eius consumitur,” Lumian alta voce cogitavit: “Exspectemus occasionem ut Bansy Portum visitare aut in Trier Quarta Aetate intrare possimus, et deinde eam temptare potestis.”

source: Besides, Madam Magician said that without the Blood Emperor’s residual aura, a specific ritual is needed to assist, and no one knows yet what that ritual is like.
target: Praeterea, Magistra Magica dixit sine aura residua Imperatoris Sanguinis, ritualem singularem auxilium requiri, nec quisquam adhuc novit quo modo hic rituus sit.

source: Maybe once we’re in Bansy or Fourth Epoch Trier, influenced by the environment, we won’t need the ritual anymore.”
target: Forsitan, cum in Bansy aut Trier Quarta Aetate erimus, ambiente affecti, ritualem amplius non indigebimus.

source: “That’ll do,” Franca relented.
target: “Ita satis,” Franca concessit.

source: A corpse wax candle that could only be used four more times obviously needed to be reserved for the best occasions.
target: Candela cera ex cadavere, quae solum quater iteribus usui adhiberi posset, manifeste ad optimas occasiones reservanda erat.

source: Franca turned to Lumian.
target: Franca ad Lumian se convertit.

source: Franca, brimming with enthusiasm, said to Lumian, “Let’s see the Demoness of Despair’s potion formula.”
target: Franca, studio pleno, ad Lumian dixit: “Videamus formula potionis Demonessae Desperationis.”

source: “What’s my reward?” Lumian joked.
target: “Quid mihi praemium est?” Lumian iocose dixit.

source: Franca clicked her tongue.
target: Franca lingua strinxit.

source: “I’ll keep an eye out at the Demoness Sect for any mystical items that can change gender and give it to you for free.”
target: “In Secta Demonessa observabo, si qua res mystica ad genus mutandum inveniatur, et tibi libere tradam.”

source: With that, Franca’s smile grew even brighter, her eyes sparkling.
target: Hoc facto, risus Francae lucidius effulsit, et oculi eius fulgentes erant.

source: “I really look forward to that day.”
target: “Illum diem vere exspecto.”

source: Jenna imagined it for a moment and found herself also a bit excited.
target: Jenna per momentum id imaginavit et se aliquantulum excitatam invenit.

source: Considering the potential consequences of debating over this topic, Lumian pretended to be at a loss for words and quickly took out a sheet of delicate human skin from his Traveler’s Bag and laid it on the coffee table.
target: Consideratis consequentiis potentialibus huius argumenti, Lumian se verbis carere simulavit et celeriter paginam cutis humanae delicatae ex sacco Viatoris extraxit atque in mensa posuit.

source: The three only glanced at the potion formula before swiftly moving away, taking a moment before returning to continue.
target: Tres tantum formulae potionis intuerunt, deinde celeriter se avulsere, paulisper morantes antequam redeunt ad continuandum.

source: After a few repeats, the contents of the Sequence 4 potion formula fully emerged in their minds: “Name: Despair; “Sequence: 4; “Main ingredients: Plague Mother Serpent’s venom sac; Silver Hunter’s crystal; “Supplementary ingredients: 10 milliliters of Plague Mother Serpent’s bile, three fragments of the Silver Hunter, a fresh branch of mistletoe, and 10 milliliters of blood from seven victims who died from different plagues.
target: Post paucas repetitiones, contenta formulae potionis Sequenciae IV plane in eorum animis emergere coeperunt: “Nomen: Desperatio; Sequencia: IV; Ingredientes principales: vesica venenata Serpentis Matris Pestis; crystallum Argenti Venatoris; Ingredientes supplementarii: 10 millilitra bilis Serpentis Matris Pestis, tres fracta Argenti Venatoris, ramus recens visci, et 10 millilitra sanguinis ex septem victimis, qui variis pestibus mortui sunt.”

source: “Ritual: Involve over thirty thousand people in a severe plague.
target: “Ritus: Involvere plus quam triginta milia hominum in pesti gravis.

source: The more who die, the stronger the despair and suffering, the better the ritual effect.”
target: Quo magis moriantur, eo fortior desperatio et miseria, eo melior effectus rituus.

source: In a brief silence, Franca hissed, “Isn’t this ritual too evil?
target: In brevi silentio, Franca sibilavit: “Nonne hic rituus nimis malus est?”

source: I can’t do such a thing!”
target: “Non possum talem rem facere!”

source: She felt that if she succumbed to the urge to advance, to become a demigod, and caused such a plague, she would truly fall and truly become a Demoness!
target: Sensi se, si impulsu ad progressum cedisset ut semidea fieret, et talem pestem attulisset, vere corrueret atque vere Demonessa fieret!

source: Jenna shook her head, her face full of fear.
target: Jenna capite concussit, vultu metu pleno.

source: She couldn’t imagine becoming that kind of person.
target: Non se poterat fingere talem fieri.

source: She would rather stay forever at the Demoness of Affliction Sequence!
target: Malim in Sequencia Demonessae Afflictionis in aeternum manere!

source: “It’s not just about being evil, it’s obviously more difficult than the Iron-blooded Knight’s ascension ritual,” Lumian said from another angle.
target: “Non solum maleficium concernit, sed prorsus difficilius est quam rituus ascensionis Equitis Ferro-Sanguinei,” Lumian ex alia parte dixit.

source: Using the capabilities of the Demoness of Affliction along with auxiliary media and items, turning a contagion into a plague that swept through thirty thousand people wasn’t too challenging.
target: Usus facultatum Demonessae Afflictionis una cum mediis et rebus auxiliariis, contagionem in pestem vertens quae triginta milia hominum pervasit, non nimis arduum fuit.

source: However, in any city with such a large population, official organizations existed, and they would likely notice the outbreak soon after it began.
target: Attamen, in quacumque urbe cum tanta populatione, institutiones oficiales exsistant, et cito post initium pestis eam animadverterent.

source: That would lead to targeted interventions and possibly even identification of the disease’s source—the Demoness of Affliction herself—leading to her elimination.
target: Id ad interventiones destinatas et fortasse etiam ad fons morbi (Demonessae Afflictionis ipsius) cognoscendum ducet, quae ad eius exterminationem perveniat.

source: If she avoided cities and spread the disease from one small town or village to another, it would take an exceedingly long time.
target: Si urbēs vitaret et morbum ex uno parvo oppido in alium disseminaret, longum nimis tempus requereret.

source: The longer the process dragged on, the greater the chance of various mishaps that could cause the ritual to fail.
target: Quo diutius processus perdurabit, eo maior occasio variarum infortunior, quae rituum infaustum reddere possint.

source: For example, discovery by the official Beyonders, natural containment of the disease, or other unforeseen events.
target: Exempli causa, inventio ab Beyonders officialibus, continentia naturalis morbi, aut aliae casus inopinati.

source: Compared to this, the Southern Continent might be more suitable for the Demoness of Affliction to advance.
target: Comparata hoc, Continentia Meridionalis fortasse magis idonea esset ut Demonessa Afflictionis progrediatur.

source: “Yes,” Franca said with a pained expression, “Is there no way to bypass this ritual?
target: “Ita,” Franca vultu dolenti dixit, “Nonne via est hunc rituum praeterire?”

source: Or is there an equivalent, less evil ritual?”
target: Aut an equivalens rituus est, minus maleficus?

source: Jenna racked her brain but couldn’t think of any shortcuts that didn’t involve killing innocents.
target: Jenna mentem percontavit sed nullas vias breves invenire potuit, quae non implicarent interficere innocentes.

source: Lumian, with a carefree smile, said, “It’s simple.
target: Lumian, subridens leviter, dixit: “Simplex est.

source: After you reach Sequence 5, you could switch to Iron-blooded Knight.
target: Postquam Sequenciam V pertinges, poteris in Equitem Ferro-Sanguinei convertere.

source: If you care—or rather, prefer to remain a Demoness—you can then check whether the ritual of the Demoness of Unaging is evil.
target: Si cuperis—vel potius, manere Demonessa mavis—deinde perscrutari potes an rituus Demonessae Non Senescendi malus sit.

source: If it isn’t, you could switch back.”
target: Si non est, poteris revertere.

source: “Uh…” Franca and Jenna were stunned.
target: “Uh…” Franca et Jenna obstupefactae erant.
